verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a GPU compute platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only one-off job execution: an agent rents a pod, runs a job, and removes it, plus TTL, end-time and spend-cap auto-deletion. The 6-hour volume backup is a platform-side behavior, not a user-defined recurring schedule. Nothing documents a cron-like or recurring job or workflow scheduler.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
